memory.estimateReason: Allows for a .NET build and test run with the default pool of three PostgreSQL containers at 256 MiB each; replace with a measured successful-run peak.

competitive-baseline.estimateReason: TT-032 serial discovery runs reuse the cached PostgreSQL image and NuGet cache; allow 2 GiB for controller image, database volumes, builds and raw samples, plus 1 GiB temporary headroom. No unrelated cache cleanup is authorized.

verification.estimateReason: Release builds and fast/native verification reuse existing NuGet and build caches; allow 1 GiB of new reports and temporary output while preserving 4 GiB of free space.
